title: Setup: one page header and one list shell for sys_* lists, metadata-type pages and settings pages
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, the Setup app at 1024 px and 1280 px. Four page shells sit side by side in one sidebar:

1. `sys_*` record lists (Users, Teams, Invitations, Sharing Rules, Sessions, API Keys, Approval Requests, Audit Logs, Notification Preferences…): the console page header (icon, title, a kind chip such as "Identity" / "System-managed" / "Platform schema" / "Admin config", a one-line description) over the list chrome with view tabs, "N more", Filter / Sort / Display, the `#` column and an Actions column.
2. Metadata-type pages (Positions, Capabilities, Permission Sets at `/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment and its siblings`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`): a breadcrumb "All Metadata Types › Position", the type name with chips (`position` · SECURITY · create-only), two stat tiles ITEMS 18 / FILTERED 18, a search box, an "All sources (18)" select, a NAME / LABEL / DESCRIPTION / ACTIVE / SOURCE table whose every row carries an "Artifact" chip, and `New` at the right.
3. Settings pages (`/apps/setup/system/settings/mail`, `storage`, `ai`, `knowledge`, `feature_flags`): a page header, a "← All settings" link, section headings with a muted sentence, fields and toggles.
4. Component pages (Packages, Packaged automation, Approvals Inbox, Audit Log Browser, Datasources, Connect an Agent, App Marketplace): each with its own header (some with a top-right pencil, some with Refresh in the header, some with none).

Positions and Users are two rows apart in the sidebar and share nothing but the sidebar.

## Target

1. One Setup page header for all four kinds: 32 px icon tile, 18 px / 600 title, the kind chip, a 13 px muted description, the primary action at the right (New / Invite / Register…), Refresh as an icon button where a page has it. The header the console pages already draw (objectui#12553) is the base.
2. Metadata-type pages inside Setup drop the "All Metadata Types" breadcrumb and the ITEMS / FILTERED tiles; the count becomes "18 items" in the header's description line; the source select stays as a filter chip; the table takes the console list's row height and typography; the "Artifact" chip is a tooltip on the source column, not a chip per row.
3. Record lists inside Setup drop the `#` row-number column and nothing else. The Display control and the view-tab strip stay as they are on every list: the strip already folds what its width does not hold into "N more" (objectui#12440), and Display holds the view's own presentation (group, hide fields, density, row numbers, export; a Layout row only when the object offers more than one), which an admin uses on Audit Logs and Approval Requests. No view-count gate. Maintainer ruling 2026-10-16, after the PM's read of the fold rule and of what Display holds, verbatim: 「可以」; the smaller icon-only form of Filter / Sort / Display for every list is objectui#12695.
4. Settings pages keep their form but take the same header; "← All settings" becomes the breadcrumb's first crumb.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx` (Setup posture), the settings hub pages under `system/settings/*` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/`, the Setup component pages under `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/` and `apps/console/src/registerSystemComponents.tsx`, tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark, of Users, Positions, Mail Delivery and Packages: the title sits at the same x and y on all four; one header component in the tree.
2. Tests: the metadata-type page under the Setup route renders no breadcrumb and no stat tiles; the record list under Setup renders no `#` column.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- The metadata-type page outside Setup (the Studio "Open in Setup" target and the directory) keeps today's shape; the change is a posture for the Setup route.
- Existing `data-testid`s stay.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-positions-metadata-page.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-positions-metadata-page.png?raw=true) · [setup-invitations-empty.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-invitations-empty.png?raw=true) · [setup-packaged-automation.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-packaged-automation.png?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>

<sub>Body refreshed 2026-10-16T13:53Z: Target 3 rewritten per the maintainer's 2026-10-16 ruling (no view-count gate on Display or "N more"; only the `#` column goes; icon-only toolbar is objectui#12695); the rest unchanged.</sub>
